ITEM 1 | Bright to dark green leafy greens, soft wilted leaves with smooth, slightly glossy surfaces and visible pale green stems about 0.5 cm thick, piled in a mound covering roughly 45% of a white square plate (plate about 26 cm across), leaves about 6-10 cm long, moderately heaped to about 3-4 cm high, sitting directly on the plate with a few darker red-brown wilted bits mixed in | 85

ITEM 2 | Small pale golden-tan nut or seed pieces, irregular flat shapes about 0.5-1 cm, dry and matte, scattered loosely around the greens and at the plate's left edge and lower area, covering under 3% of the plate | 6

ITEM 3 | Creamy white dressing or sauce, opaque and slightly glossy, in small dollops and streaks about 1-2 cm across, clinging to some leaves and the greens near the center and right side, thin layer under 1 mm thick, covering about 3% of the plate | 4

ITEM 4 | Dark reddish-brown wilted pieces, soft and slightly shriveled with a matte surface, small clusters about 1-2 cm across tucked among the greens in the center, covering about 3% of the plate and about 1 cm high | 5
